selection_rule.benefit: equal-condition mean noise power reduction dB over 144 registered-interval cases
selection_rule.loss: maximum of worst-recording percentage losses in total Clean, 2-4 kHz Clean, and 4-8 kHz Clean
selection_rule.score: benefit divided by maximum observed benefit minus loss divided by loss at that benefit endpoint
selection_rule.reference: bypass origin; same coarse endpoint retained in refined scan
selection_rule.scope: common across all three noises and four SNRs; exact single-pass response; two highest-scoring Pareto settings

limitations: Ranking is a declared engineering energy/noise criterion, not a standard intelligibility metric.
Weak-band safeguard uses the worst loss across total, 2-4 kHz and 4-8 kHz speech energy; results depend on this criterion and search endpoints.
N=16 is the highest tested prototype order, so an optimal finite order has not been established.
The best two spectra-only settings are very close; 1 Hz cutoff differences are not independently resolved by 7.8125 Hz PSD bins.
Causal single-pass response assumed; forward-backward application would change magnitude and order.
Same 12 sentences and 144 mixtures used for design; no independent evaluation split established.
No SS, Wiener or Log-MMSE outputs, STOI/ESTOI values, or new WAVs generated.
